tagline: Give an agent a goal. Watch it improve its own harness.

scenes.title: Agents that improve their own harness
scenes.narration: This is Harnessmith. You give it a goal, it runs an agent on it, and then it improves the agent's harness for that goal: the instructions, rules and tools around the model. Here is a quick tour.

scenes.title: The whole system on one page
scenes.narration: The Overview shows the whole system on one page. Every goal passes a gate, waits in a queue, and gets its own run slot. Inside the slot, the solver attempts the goal, an improver proposes and composes edits, a blind selector picks the best output, and a lesson is saved for next time.

scenes.title: Describe what you want
scenes.narration: To start, describe what you want. Templates give you a goal, grading criteria and a domain to begin from. Below, the estimate shows how many solver runs and improver sessions the goal will use, with time and tokens for each role. Press Start, and the run is queued.

focus.label: Runs, time and tokens per role

scenes.title: What runs best on this machine
scenes.narration: The Models tab starts with an advisor. It reads your hardware, recommends a model for each role, and offers one-click setups: all local, a local solver with a hosted improver, or all NVIDIA.

focus.label: A model for each role
focus.cue: recommends a model for each role

scenes.title: Connections and keys
scenes.narration: Connections are where models come from. Paste a key as a name, an equals sign, and the key, and it is saved to a private dot env file. The form never shows it again; it only says whether the key is set. Save and test checks that the model really answers.

focus.label: Your saved connections
focus.cue: Connections are where models come from

focus.label: Only says whether it is set
focus.cue: it only says whether the key is set

focus.label: Save and test in one click

scenes.title: Every goal, searchable
scenes.narration: History lists every goal by day. Search and filters narrow the list, and each goal shows its status, score and run time. Open one, and a summary shows the last run, the score against the base attempt, and how long it took.

focus.label: Goals grouped by day
focus.cue: History lists every goal by day

focus.label: Last run, score, time
focus.cue: a summary shows the last run

scenes.title: How the run moved
scenes.narration: The journey map shows how the run moved through the pipeline: the base run, two proposals, the composed harness, and the selection. Each box shows its model, steps and time, and self-heals are marked.

focus.label: The run, stage by stage
focus.cue: how the run moved through the pipeline

scenes.title: The deliverable, rendered
scenes.narration: The output tab renders the deliverable. This report still has placeholders like Your Name, which the review now catches, so a run like this ends as needs review instead of done.

scenes.title: Base beside adopted
scenes.narration: Compare puts the first base attempt beside the adopted output, with changed lines highlighted. From a goal you can also run an A/B test, a model shootout, or download a report.

scenes.title: Is adaptation helping?
scenes.narration: Results answers one question: is adapting the harness helping? It shows wins, the average lift in points, how often the base attempt was kept, and the spend and time for each goal.

focus.label: Wins, lift, base kept, spend, time
Every goal, scored
focus.cue: the spend and time for each goal

scenes.title: Lessons for later goals
scenes.narration: Each adopted harness leaves a lesson in the library. Later goals in the same domain read these lessons first. Pin a lesson you trust, or retire one that no longer helps.

focus.label: A lesson from a past goal
focus.cue: leaves a lesson in the library

scenes.title: What the agent can call
scenes.narration: The base harness tab lists the tools the agent can call, including export PDF, which turns Markdown into a real PDF, and optional web tools for reading and searching pages.

focus.label: Built-in tools
focus.cue: the tools the agent can call

scenes.title: Checks and safe fixes
scenes.narration: The Doctor checks everything around a run: models and their keys, recent runs, projects, storage and tools. It leads with what needs attention, each with a next step, and fixes what it safely can on its own.

focus.label: What needs attention, and why
focus.cue: It leads with what needs attention

scenes.title: Give it a goal
scenes.narration: That is Harnessmith. Give it a goal, connect a model, and let it improve its own harness. It runs on your machine, and your keys stay in your own dot env file.
